title: Metricool Pricing 2026: Free, Starter & Advanced Plans
summary: Metricool pricing offers four monthly plans from $29 to $399, helping you identify the tier matching your team's size and needs.
body_markdown:
## Metricool Reporting and Approvals with Activepieces


Don't expect[Activepieces](https://www.activepieces.com/) to replace Metricool or lower its bill.


It's a workflow automation tool that connects apps so one action triggers another, and it fills two gaps Metricool leaves, which are an approval step before content reaches the scheduler and automatic reports sent to the places your team already reads.


### Where a workflow helps


If you run several brands, the cost of doing nothing is a wrong post going live under the wrong client's name.


A workflow puts a checkpoint in front of that. The draft is submitted, a reviewer gets an approve button, and only an approved post moves into Metricool's scheduler.


Nothing reaches the queue on a hunch. Rejected drafts go back to the writer with a note instead of sitting unseen.


The second use runs the other direction. Metricool can produce reports, but someone has to remember to open them and forward them.


A workflow can take that data on a schedule and drop it into Slack (the team chat app), a Google Sheets spreadsheet, or an email. Your client sees numbers without anyone logging in to fetch them.


In the illustration below, a draft passes through the approval step before the scheduler, and a second branch from Metricool carries a report out to Slack, Sheets and email.


Activepieces sits on either side of Metricool and never in place of it, and it meters the run rather than the steps: its pricing page lists 1 credit per flow run, so a ten-step approval chain costs what a two-step one does, whereas Zapier's per-task billing and Make's per-module billing each count every step on their own pricing pages.


Once the paths are clear, the practical question is whether your plan lets the two tools talk at all.


### What Metricool's plan allows for integrations


I can't confirm from Metricool's documentation which API or integration access each plan includes, so I won't guess.


Check Metricool's current API documentation and plan comparison page before you build anything, because a workflow that depends on access your tier lacks is wasted setup.


Ask support in writing which plan unlocks it, and keep the answer. Then price that tier, not the cheapest one, into your budget.
